categories.main_business_segments: Tapestry, Inc. operates three primary business segments: Coach, Kate Spade, and Stuart Weitzman. Coach is the largest segment, representing nearly 80% of fiscal 2025 net sales, followed by Kate Spade at 17%, and Stuart Weitzman at 3%. The company completed the sale of the Stuart Weitzman business in August 2025. Each brand operates globally and maintains distinct product and customer positioning.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Tapestry leverages dedicated design and merchandising teams for each brand, supported by advanced data analytics, AI, and machine learning for customer insights, planning, and personalization. Products are manufactured by a network of independent suppliers, primarily in Vietnam, Cambodia, the Philippines, India, China, and Spain, with rigorous quality and social compliance standards. The company maintains strong oversight of sourcing, quality control, and fulfillment through regional offices and integrated ERP systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tapestry serves a broad base of fashion-conscious consumers, with a focus on women for Coach and Kate Spade, and both women and men for Stuart Weitzman. Key end markets include handbags, accessories, footwear, and lifestyle products, sold through direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels (retail, outlet, e-commerce), wholesale partners (department and specialty stores), and licensing arrangements. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of segment sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with North America and Greater China as its largest markets, followed by Japan, Europe, and other parts of Asia. As of June 2025, Tapestry had 1,371 stores worldwide, with significant e-commerce presence in the U.S., Canada, Japan, Greater China, Europe, Australia, and other Asian markets. Approximately 40% of net sales are generated outside the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tapestry is positioned as a downstream, consumer-facing brand owner and retailer, controlling design, marketing, and distribution of its products. It outsources manufacturing to third-party suppliers but maintains oversight of sourcing, quality, and compliance. The company manages fulfillment and distribution through a mix of owned and third-party operated centers globally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's 'futurespeed' growth strategy focuses on building lasting customer relationships, fueling fashion innovation and product excellence, delivering compelling omni-channel experiences, and powering global growth, especially in North America and China. R&D and innovation efforts emphasize digital transformation, AI-driven personalization, sustainability, and product development in core and adjacent categories. Corporate responsibility and sustainability are integral to product and operational innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Tapestry generates revenue primarily through direct sales of branded products via its own retail stores, outlets, and e-commerce platforms (86% of net sales), supplemented by wholesale distribution (13%) and licensing royalties (about 1%). Licensing covers categories such as eyewear, watches, fragrance, and accessories, with royalties based on licensee sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tapestry faces intense competition from global and regional brands in the luxury and accessible luxury segments, including players like Michael Kors, Ralph Lauren, Tory Burch, and other fashion houses. The company competes on style, price, quality, brand prestige, and omni-channel experience, leveraging strong brand recognition and a robust digital platform to maintain its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2025, Tapestry reported net sales of $7.01 billion, up 5.1% from the prior year, with a gross margin of 75.4%. Adjusted (non-GAAP) net income was $1.13 billion, reflecting a 13.4% increase year-over-year, though GAAP net income was $183 million due to impairment and acquisition-related charges. The company maintains a large global footprint, strong cash flow, and a history of returning capital to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tapestry emphasizes iconic, innovative, and high-quality products with distinctive brand identities and customer experiences. Its value proposition centers on craftsmanship, authenticity, and emotional brand connection, supported by omni-channel accessibility and personalized engagement. Sustainability, inclusivity, and corporate responsibility further differentiate Tapestry in the global fashion and accessories market.
